summary: Partition UTF-8 string into graphemes by complex boundary rules; answer queries about grapheme sequences.

traps.quote: apply the first matching rule ... rule order is authoritative
traps.consequence: Checking rules as accumulated conditions instead of first-match-wins produces wrong boundary positions.
traps.guard: Iterate rules 1–6 in order; stop at first match and skip all remaining rules.

traps.quote: broadcasts use UTF-16 code-unit offsets ... larger scalar occupies two UTF-16 code units
traps.consequence: Outputting byte or grapheme offsets instead of UTF-16 code-unit positions produces wrong query answers.
traps.guard: Precompute UTF-16 offset for every grapheme boundary; output offsets/distances in UTF-16 code units.

traps.consequence: O(|S|) per query = 1.8×10^11 operations; solution times out.
traps.guard: Precompute all boundaries and UTF-16 offsets in O(|S|); answer queries in O(1).

traps.quote: resolve index x to x when nonnegative and G+x when negative, then clamp to [0,G]
traps.consequence: Clamping before resolving negative indices produces out-of-range or wrong indices.
traps.guard: Resolve negative indices first (x → G+x), then clamp result to [0,G].

traps.quote: If there are G graphemes, ... clamp it to [0,G]
traps.consequence: Assuming G boundaries instead of G+1 causes off-by-one errors.
traps.guard: Recall G graphemes produce G+1 boundaries, indexed 0 through G inclusive.

traps.consequence: Checking only U+0000..U+001F and missing U+007F..U+009F causes wrong boundaries on extended ASCII controls.
traps.guard: Implement control check for both ranges: ASCII (U+0000–U+001F) AND extended (U+007F–U+009F).

input_shape: UTF-8 string S (600KB max); Q queries (300K max) with signed 64-bit indices.
output_shape: Two integers per query: UTF-16 offsets or code-unit counts.
invariants: Boundaries determined by first matching of six numbered rules, not merged/accumulated conditions.
All output uses UTF-16 encoding: scalars > U+FFFF occupy two code units.
G graphemes produce G+1 boundaries indexed [0, G] inclusive.
